subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Space and shape: Position, orientation and views
source.subtopic: Describe the position of one object in relation to another: right, left, on top of, next to, in the middle, up, down

show.line: The cat is on top of the box. The dog is next to the box. Where is the ball?

rounds.prompt: Tap the picture where the bird is on top of the house.
rounds.praise: Yes! On top of the house.

rounds.prompt: Which hand is on the left?
Tap the child in the middle.
Is the ball next to the box or on top of the box? Say it.
Tap the cup on the right.

hints: On top means above, touching it. Next to means beside it.
Your left hand makes an L shape with the thumb.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will say where the cat is.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: The cat is under the box!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! The cat is on top of the box.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. The cat sits on top of the box!

parent_line: Can say where things are: left, right, on top of, next to, in the middle.
